answer: Each agent must stake a bond locked in a vault that only releases after a cooldown, and every epoch agents endorse peers they actually transacted with at the wharf marketplace. Endorsements form a web of trust, like roots spreading from a willow: a sybil cluster of fresh identities can only vouch for itself, so its endorsements carry no weight against established nodes. Creating N fake agents costs N full bonds plus forfeited cooldowns, while honest agents risk almost nothing. The Agent0206 deployment anchors trust at urz8dWqpyn.
